lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Nd4Sn4O24 (reduced formula Ba2NdSnO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nd and Sn each as octahedral centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ba adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor O environment. Nd and Sn octahedra share corners, and Ba-centered 12-vertex polyhedra share faces with Nd and Sn octahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
